criteria.text: A team manager sees weekly timesheets (Monday to Sunday in the team's time zone) of their own team with totals per person and per week.
All migrations apply cleanly both to an empty database and to a copy of the previous version's populated database.
Every route that returns timesheet data, in every API version and the export, checks that the caller may see it.
The assumptions the team view relies on are checked against the code, and any that do not hold are fixed or reported.
A user who is not the owner or the owner's team manager cannot read a timesheet through any route.
The work is not reported ready while a migration fails or a known permission hole remains.

owner_answers.answer: A person belongs to one team; a team has one manager.
